body.heading: Stomp to the music
paragraphs: When the music plays, stomp and sway like a huge, friendly dinosaur. Big slow steps. Little arms.
Roar quietly if you are indoors. Dinosaurs can be polite too.

body.heading: Freeze like a fossil
paragraphs: When the music stops, freeze! Dinosaurs stood still for millions of years as fossils, so you can manage ten seconds.
Anyone who wobbles becomes a statue with a giggle. Start the music and stomp again.

takeaway: Dinosaurs may be gone, but their stomps live on in this game.
safetyNotes: Clear the space first and stomp on carpet or grass so feet and neighbours stay happy.
screenFreeExtension: Invent dances for other creatures: the crab sidestep, the penguin waddle, the frog jump.
